+++ b/src/click/open_binary_reader.py
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from ._compat import _is_binary_reader
+
+
+def open_binary_reader(stream: t.IO[t.Any]) -> t.BinaryIO | None:
+    """Like :func:`click._compat._find_binary_reader`, but a closed
+    ``buffer`` fallback is rejected instead of assumed to be binary.
+    """
+    if _is_binary_reader(stream, False):
+        return t.cast(t.BinaryIO, stream)
+
+    buf = getattr(stream, "buffer", None)
+
+    if buf is None or getattr(buf, "closed", False):
+        return None
+
+    if _is_binary_reader(buf, True):
+        return t.cast(t.BinaryIO, buf)
+
+    return None
diff --git a/tests/test_open_binary_reader.py b/tests/test_open_binary_reader.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4e195de

+++ b/tests/test_open_binary_reader.py
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+import io
+
+import pytest
+
+from click._compat import _find_binary_reader
+from click.open_binary_reader import open_binary_reader
+
+
+class _Wrapper:
+    def __init__(self, buffer):
+        self.buffer = buffer
+
+    def read(self, n=-1):
+        return ""
+
+
+class _RaisingBuffer:
+    def read(self, n=-1):
+        raise OSError("not readable")
+
+
+def test_binary_stream_returned():
+    stream = io.BytesIO(b"")
+    assert open_binary_reader(stream) is stream
+
+
+def test_closed_binary_stream_not_returned_directly():
+    stream = io.BytesIO(b"")
+    stream.close()
+    assert open_binary_reader(stream) is None
+    assert _find_binary_reader(stream) is None
+
+
+def test_open_buffer_returned():
+    buf = io.BytesIO(b"data")
+    stream = io.TextIOWrapper(buf)
+    assert open_binary_reader(stream) is buf
+
+
+def test_closed_buffer_rejected():
+    buf = io.BytesIO(b"")
+    buf.close()
+    stream = _Wrapper(buf)
+    assert _find_binary_reader(stream) is buf
+    assert open_binary_reader(stream) is None
+
+
+def test_text_stream_without_buffer():
+    assert open_binary_reader(io.StringIO("")) is None
+
+
+def test_text_buffer_rejected():
+    assert open_binary_reader(_Wrapper(io.StringIO(""))) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "stream",
+    [_Wrapper(_RaisingBuffer()), _Wrapper(None), io.StringIO("x")],
+)
+def test_matches_find_binary_reader(stream):
+    assert open_binary_reader(stream) is _find_binary_reader(stream)
notes:
Added open_binary_reader, which mirrors _find_binary_reader by reusing _is_binary_reader, but returns None when the fallback .buffer is closed instead of assuming it is binary. Tests compare it against the original for the other cases.
